# Startup task coverage

Common startup lifecycle and conditional commerce, marketplace, consumption-billing, services, physical-product, international, regulated-product and exit coordination needs.

A mapped guide is an entry point for the named need. This inventory does not establish universal completeness, country-law coverage, expert review or verified execution.

Mapped guide entry points: **143 / 143 named needs**. The catalog has 209 process guides and 33 situation guides.

Use each guide’s applicability, completion checks and approval requirements. Operational drafts require the stated specialist review before regulated or professional work proceeds.

| Manage vendor renewals and orderly offboarding | Before a vendor contract renews, changes scope or ends. | [Manage vendor renewals and orderly offboarding](../open-processes/pages/manage-vendor-renewals-and-orderly-offboarding.md) |
| Manage workplace safety and emergency readiness | When operating premises, employing people in physical work or changing workplace hazards. | [Manage workplace safety and emergency readiness](../open-processes/pages/manage-workplace-safety-and-emergency-readiness.md) |
| Track company assets and equipment | When buying, assigning, moving, returning or disposing of company equipment. | [Track company assets and equipment](../open-processes/pages/track-company-assets-and-equipment.md) |

## Event response

| Need | Applies when | Guides |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Respond to a cease-and-desist | A cease-and-desist letter claiming trademark or IP infringement arrives by mail or email. | [Respond to a cease-and-desist](../open-processes/pages/respond-to-a-cease-and-desist.md) |
| Unstick a delayed US visa | Your US visa is stuck (221(g) administrative processing after the interview, or a petition sitting past posted times) while the company needs you in Silicon Valley. | [Unstick a delayed US visa](../open-processes/pages/unstick-a-delayed-us-visa.md) |
| Respond to a data breach | You discover unauthorized access to customer or company data: a breach is live or just happened. | [Respond to a data breach](../open-processes/pages/respond-to-a-data-breach.md) |
| Answer a tax-authority notice | A tax-authority notice arrives claiming a discrepancy, a balance due, or a missing filing. | [Answer a tax-authority notice](../open-processes/pages/answer-an-irs-or-state-tax-notice.md) |
| Recover from a frozen bank account or bank failure | Your operating account is frozen by the bank's compliance review, or the bank itself fails. | [Recover from a frozen bank account or bank failure](../open-processes/pages/recover-from-a-frozen-bank-account-or-bank-failure.md) |
| Contain a chargeback or fraud spike | Your dispute rate jumps: a chargeback wave or a card-testing/fraud spike is hitting your payments. | [Contain a chargeback or fraud spike](../open-processes/pages/contain-a-chargeback-or-fraud-spike.md) |
| Handle a co-founder departure | A co-founder is leaving (resignation or a split) and the vesting, IP, and access mechanics start now. | [Handle a co-founder departure](../open-processes/pages/handle-a-co-founder-departure.md) |
| Respond to a lawsuit | You've been served: a process server hands you a summons and complaint naming the company. | [Respond to a lawsuit](../open-processes/pages/respond-to-a-lawsuit.md) |
| Respond to a trademark office action | The trademark examiner issues an office action against your application: refusals or requirements with a response deadline. | [Respond to a trademark office action](../open-processes/pages/respond-to-a-trademark-office-action.md) |
| Cure a Delaware franchise tax delinquency | A Delaware delinquency notice arrives: the March 1 annual report/franchise tax was missed and good standing is gone or going. | [Cure a Delaware franchise tax delinquency](../open-processes/pages/cure-a-delaware-franchise-tax-delinquency.md) |
| Survive a DDoS attack or major outage | Traffic spikes take the product down: a DDoS attack is live, or a major outage looks like one. | [Survive a DDoS attack or major outage](../open-processes/pages/survive-a-ddos-attack-or-major-outage.md) |
| Migrate off a shutting-down vendor | A vendor you depend on announces a shutdown or sunsets the product you're built on. | [Migrate off a shutting-down vendor](../open-processes/pages/migrate-off-a-shutting-down-vendor.md) |
| Recover from a payment-processor account termination | Your payment processor emails that your account is terminated or restricted; payouts pause and a final processing date is set. | [Recover from a payment-processor account termination](../open-processes/pages/recover-from-a-payment-processor-account-termination.md) |
| Handle a security-vulnerability report | A security researcher (or a customer, or a stranger) reports a vulnerability in your product, responsibly so far. | [Handle a security-vulnerability report](../open-processes/pages/handle-a-security-vulnerability-report.md) |
| Answer a data-subject access request | Someone exercises their data rights: a GDPR subject access request or CCPA request to know/delete lands in any inbox. | [Answer a data-subject access request](../open-processes/pages/answer-a-data-subject-access-request.md) |
| Recover from an app-store rejection or removal | Your app is rejected in review, or pulled from the App Store or Google Play with a policy notice. | [Recover from an app-store rejection or removal](../open-processes/pages/recover-from-an-app-store-rejection-or-removal.md) |
| Recover a suspended ad or platform account | Google Ads, Meta, or another ad/platform account is suspended: campaigns stop and a policy email names the violation. | [Recover a suspended ad or platform account](../open-processes/pages/recover-a-suspended-ad-or-platform-account.md) |
| Recover a hijacked domain or social account | Your domain, DNS, or a company social/email account is taken over: logins fail, records change, or posts you didn't write appear. | [Recover a hijacked domain or social account](../open-processes/pages/recover-a-hijacked-domain-or-social-account.md) |
| Handle a key employee's resignation | A key employee resigns: notice is in hand and the transition starts now. | [Handle a key employee's resignation](../open-processes/pages/handle-a-key-employee-s-resignation.md) |
| Absorb a pulled term sheet | The lead pulls the term sheet, by call or by silence, and the round you planned around is gone. | [Absorb a pulled term sheet](../open-processes/pages/absorb-a-pulled-term-sheet.md) |
| Report and manage a workplace injury | Someone is hurt at work: an injury on the job just happened and reporting deadlines may already be running. | [Report and manage a workplace injury](../open-processes/pages/report-and-manage-a-workplace-injury.md) |
| Respond to a harassment complaint | An employee reports harassment: by complaint, by email, or in a conversation that just became one. | [Respond to a harassment complaint](../open-processes/pages/respond-to-a-harassment-complaint.md) |
| Absorb the loss of your biggest customer | Your biggest customer gives notice: non-renewal, termination for convenience, or an acquisition that ends the account your revenue leans on. | [Absorb the loss of your biggest customer](../open-processes/pages/absorb-the-loss-of-your-biggest-customer.md) |
| Respond to a patent demand letter | A letter arrives asserting a patent against your product and demanding a license fee, often from a non-practicing entity (NPE). | [Respond to a patent demand letter](../open-processes/pages/respond-to-a-patent-demand-letter.md) |
| Handle a press crisis | A negative story is live and spreading: press coverage, a viral thread, or a review pile-on names your company. | [Handle a press crisis](../open-processes/pages/handle-a-press-crisis.md) |
| Cure a venture-debt covenant default | Your venture-debt lender flags a covenant breach, or your own numbers show one: a financial covenant missed, a MAC clause in play, or a milestone default. | [Cure a venture-debt covenant default](../open-processes/pages/cure-a-venture-debt-covenant-default.md) |
| Handle an employee's visa denial or RFE | An RFE or a denial lands on an employee's work-visa petition, and their authorization to keep working now has a clock on it. | [Respond to an employee work-authorization refusal or evidence request](../open-processes/pages/handle-an-employee-s-visa-denial-or-rfe.md) |
| Avert a missed payroll | The cash forecast says the next payroll will not clear: you are weeks from out of cash, or the provider's funding debit just failed. | [Avert a missed payroll](../open-processes/pages/avert-a-missed-payroll.md) |
| Run a reduction in force | The decision is made: the plan no longer supports the team, and a reduction in force is how the company survives. | [Run a reduction in force](../open-processes/pages/run-a-reduction-in-force.md) |
| Take a down round or recap | The only real term sheet prices the company below the last round, or the insiders propose a recapitalization as the condition of new money. | [Take a down round or recap](../open-processes/pages/take-a-down-round-or-recap.md) |
| Recover from a missed 83(b) deadline | You discover the 83(b) election was never filed, and the 30-day window from the stock purchase has passed. | [Recover from a missed 83(b) deadline](../open-processes/pages/recover-from-a-missed-83-b-deadline.md) |
| Respond to an acquisition approach | An acquirer reaches out: a corp-dev email, a partner-meeting invitation, or a direct offer to buy the company. | [Respond to an acquisition approach](../open-processes/pages/respond-to-an-acquisition-approach.md) |
| Respond to a government subpoena or data request | A government subpoena, court order, or warrant arrives demanding user data or company records, sometimes with a nondisclosure order attached. | [Respond to a government subpoena or data request](../open-processes/pages/respond-to-a-government-subpoena-or-data-request.md) |

## How coverage is measured

The named-needs inventory measures whether a relevant process entry point exists. The country table measures only the launch areas explicitly authored above. Neither measure establishes that every possible business activity or local obligation has an executable reviewed procedure.

| Dimension | Evidence required |
| --- | --- |
| Business need | Applicable process or chain and its completion checks |
| Country and subnational location | Sourced procedure for the actual entity, activity and locations |
| Sector | Technical, safety and regulatory protocols for the specific product |
| Professional review | Named qualified review for the scenario and current requirements |
| Completion | Private approvals, receipts, records and verified outcomes from an actual run |

## Specialist boundaries

| Scope | Required next step |
| --- | --- |
| Clinical trials, medical-device technical files, financial-service licensing, aviation, defense, food and other sector-specific technical or legal protocols. | specialist scoping required |
| Exact country, state and municipal obligations, filing thresholds, tax positions and professional opinions. | case specific review required |
| Audit opinions, valuations, legal representation, safety certification and regulated approvals. | qualified professional required |
| Filing, signing, spending, transferring ownership, external communications and production changes. | specific human authorization required |

The regulated-market entry guide provides a scoping and approval path. Detailed clinical, financial-service, aviation, defense and other sector protocols need their own qualified workstreams. Country-specific workflow coverage remains tracked in [the law-layer coverage file](../open-law/workflow-coverage.json).
